payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brain, Gaylene, Harmony, Logan, Milly, Ronna

payload.content: Planning: Harmony available 5h, strong data-science skills. Considering low-priority documentation subtasks for ISSUE-0001; will try to avoid duplicates and keep effort within 5h.
Harmony note: lowest-cost feasible option seems ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 3.2, cost 5.77). If unclaimed, I’d like to take it in execution.

Planning update (Milly): I’m available 10h with strong data-science. Low-effort candidate best-fit is ISSUE-0001::triage (but Harmony already leaning toward it). I will prefer an unclaimed documentation subtask to avoid duplicates; next-best on my cost/effort is likely ISSUE-0001::review (effort 4h) if not taken, otherwise ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 4h) or ISSUE-0001::test (5.6h). Let me know what you plan to take so we can avoid overlap.

Milly request: please confirm which ISSUE-0001 subtasks (triage/review/docs/test/implement) and any ISSUE-0002 subtasks others are likely claiming, so I can pick a unique feasible one with minimal cost.

Planning (Logan): with 5h availability and strong documentation/data-science, I can take ISSUE-0001::review (effort 4.0, cost 3.86) or ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 3.86). I will avoid duplicates if others already plan to take them; please confirm likely claims for ISSUE-0001 triage/review/docs/test/implement and any ISSUE-0002 tasks.

Planning (Logan): I’m willing to take ISSUE-0001::review (or docs) if unclaimed; otherwise I’ll skip or take the lowest-duplication feasible doc-related task. Please avoid claiming ISSUE-0001::review/docs if I should own them.

Brain (me): availability 5h. I’m considering ISSUE-0002 infrastructure tasks (review/test/implement) since my infra skill is highest (0.83) and my costs are lowest there. Please confirm whether anyone will take ISSUE-0002::review/test/implement so I can avoid duplicates; otherwise I plan to claim the lowest-cost feasible one (likely ISSUE-0002::review). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Brain: also noting ISSUE-0001 documentation subtasks seem likely to be claimed by others (triage/review/docs). If ISSUE-0001::triage is free, my cost is high (7.95) so I prefer not to duplicate; aiming to cover ISSUE-0002 instead. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Brain: If you (Harmony/Milly/Logan) end up taking ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0002::test, I’ll take whichever of implement/review/test remains feasible within 5h, preferring lowest cost. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Ronna planning: my best-fit is data-science doc tasks, but I should avoid duplicates. From messages, Harmony likely wants ISSUE-0001::triage, Logan might take ISSUE-0001::review or docs. I can take ISSUE-0001::test (effort 5.6) if unclaimed; otherwise I’ll skip. I’m unlikely to take ISSUE-0001::implement due to high cost/effort and low priority. For ISSUE-0002 infra, only low-cost is review (but cost high for me: 20) and test (28) so I prefer skipping those if others cover.

Request back: please confirm your intended picks (esp. ISSUE-0001 triage/review/docs/test and ISSUE-0002 review/test). I will choose ISSUE-0001::test only if triage/review/docs are taken but test is still free; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicate.

Planning (Gaylene): My top skill is documentation; however my lowest-cost feasible option on ISSUE-0001 is triage (effort 3.2, cost 6.92). I see Harmony wants triage; Logan may take review/docs; Ronna may take test only if unclaimed. To avoid duplicates, I’m likely to take ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage only if triage is free; otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 8.64) as next best within 5h. I’m not taking ISSUE-0002 infra due to much higher costs for me.
Harmony planning confirmation: I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 3.2) in execution to avoid duplicates; will not claim any other ISSUE-0001 or ISSUE-0002 tasks.

Planning update from Milly: since Harmony intends ISSUE-0001::triage, I will take a different unclaimed ISSUE-0001 subtask with best fit/cost within 10h. From private costs, my cheapest remaining doc options are ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 4h, cost 9.99) then ISSUE-0001::review (effort 4h, cost 9.99). Please confirm whether either review/docs is being taken by Logan/Gaylene/Ronna; otherwise I’ll claim one of them and skip the rest.
Milly ask back: any agent taking ISSUE-0002::review/test/implement? If none, I can consider ISSUE-0002::review but my costs are high (20-40), so I’d rather avoid unless unclaimed.

Logan planning: I will claim ISSUE-0001::review (effort 4.0, cost 3.86) in execution unless someone else confirms they will take it. Otherwise, I can take ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 3.86). Please avoid claiming both to prevent duplicates.

Brain (planning): I will focus on ISSUE-0002. From current intel, no one else has definitively claimed ISSUE-0002::review/test/implement. Assuming unclaimed, I will choose ISSUE-0002::review in execution (effort 2.0 fits 5h, lowest effort/cost among infra options for me). Please confirm if any agent intends to take ISSUE-0002 in execution to avoid duplicates.

Ronna planning update: given Harmony likely taking ISSUE-0001::triage and Logan likely taking ISSUE-0001::review, I will aim for ISSUE-0001::test ONLY if review/docs remain unclaimed; otherwise I will skip. For ISSUE-0002 I will skip unless you confirm review/test/implement are all unclaimed (my costs are high: review=20, test=28). Please confirm current intended picks for ISSUE-0001::docs/review/test and any ISSUE-0002::review/test/implement claims before execution.

Gaylene planning update: I will avoid duplicates. Since Harmony intends ISSUE-0001::triage and Logan intends ISSUE-0001::review, my best non-duplicate choice is ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 4.0, cost 8.64). I will not take ISSUE-0001::test/implement. For ISSUE-0002, I’m skipping due to high cost for me.
Harmony here (planning): confirming I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage only; will not take any other ISSUE-0001 or ISSUE-0002 subtasks to avoid duplicates.

Milly planning ping: Harmony=ISSUE-0001::triage, Logan likely=ISSUE-0001::review, Gaylene likely=ISSUE-0001::docs, Brain likely=ISSUE-0002::review. To avoid duplicates, I’m considering taking ISSUE-0001::test (effort 5.6) only if it’s still free; otherwise I will skip.
Logan planning sync: I intend to take ISSUE-0001::review in execution (effort 4.0, cost 3.86). I will NOT take ISSUE-0001::docs to avoid duplicates. I also will not take any ISSUE-0002 task.

Brain planning update: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution (effort 2.0) unless someone else confirms they’ll take it. I’m not taking any ISSUE-0001 tasks (avoid overlap with Harmony/Logan/Gaylene).

Planning update from Ronna: Based on others’ confirmations—Harmony=ISSUE-0001::triage, Logan=ISSUE-0001::review, Gaylene=ISSUE-0001::docs, Brain=ISSUE-0002::review—my only remaining feasible doc subtask is ISSUE-0001::test, but likely duplicate with Milly’s consideration. I plan to skip unless ISSUE-0001::test is confirmed unclaimed; for ISSUE-0002 I will skip (review/test/implement all likely taken or too costly for me). Please confirm whether ISSUE-0001::test remains unclaimed for execution.

Ronna also confirms: cost/effort make ISSUE-0001::implement infeasible/unattractive; ISSUE-0002 tasks are too costly for my skill match. So I will either take ISSUE-0001::test (only if unclaimed) or skip.

Gaylene planning: I will take ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 4.0, low priority) to avoid duplicates since Harmony=triage and Logan=review, and Brain=ISSUE-0002::review. I will skip ISSUE-0001::test/implement and all ISSUE-0002 due to high cost.

[Harmony] Planning complete: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage only (not docs/review/test/implement; not any ISSUE-0002). This should keep tasks unique: Harmony=triage, Logan=review, Gaylene=docs, Brain=ISSUE-0002::review, leaving ISSUE-0001::test for Milly/Ronna if unclaimed.

Milly planning: confirm current intended claims appear to be Harmony=ISSUE-0001::triage, Logan=ISSUE-0001::review, Gaylene=ISSUE-0001::docs, Brain=ISSUE-0002::review. That leaves ISSUE-0001::test possibly unclaimed. I will take ISSUE-0001::test in execution if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates.

Logan planning update (phase=planning): I confirm I will take ISSUE-0001::review in execution (effort 4.0, cost 3.86) and NOT ISSUE-0001::docs nor any ISSUE-0002 tasks. Please let execution fill consider ISSUE-0001::test as remaining candidate for Milly/Ronna if still unclaimed.

Planning sync (Brain): I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution (effort 2.0, lowest cost for me on infra). Please do not claim any ISSUE-0002 tasks to avoid duplicates. For ISSUE-0001, I’m staying away from docs/review/triage/test/implement since others are covering.

Ronna planning: I will NOT take ISSUE-0002 (too costly). For ISSUE-0001, only contender is ISSUE-0001::test; I will claim it only if it is unclaimed by Milly in execution. Otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates.

Gaylene planning coordination: I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs in execution (avoid duplicates with Harmony triage, Logan review, Brain infra review, Milly/test contingent). Skipping all ISSUE-0002 due to high cost.
